comments.author: sgbg
comments.body:
It is an inland region of Africa North Coast, you can go there after making the discovery.
R11 Procurment: Sand, Ants
R11 Collection: Sand, Salt
R10+1 Search at Mammal Bones: Sand, Traveller's Notes, Fishing Gear, Wood Spear

comments.author: Destry1
comments.body:
Using search, it should be possible to get:
Rusty short sword
Wood spear
Dull cutlass
Cross-strap sandals
Fishing gear
Iron-wire Hunting net
Traveller's notes
Quadrant

Using collection or procurement, you can also get Gold Dust here.

comments.author: sgbg
comments.body: Also beside the date trees near mammal bones you will be able to discover a mysterious phenomenon "The Habbab". When your crew say something strange here go there southeast corner from the gate and when you see black smoke use recognition.
